observations.topic: Trusted drag may work despite hidden visibility
observations.result: Overstrict visible/focused guards refused before input. A scope-only probe then observed hidden/focused=true, nine trusted native pointer/drag events, four Sortable events and correct whole-group reordering. Visibility is not a universal prerequisite; validate actual events and postconditions instead.
